theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pr_orientation_sign
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid N) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (ζ : Euclid n → MultiVector N n), MeasurableSet A → (∀ u ∈ A, Injective (fderiv ℝ G u)) → AEStronglyMeasurable ζ (volume.restrict A) → (∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), IsUnitOrientationOf (ζ u) (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))))) → ∃ s : Euclid n → ℤ, Measurable s ∧ (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict A), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * ζ u α = (s u : ℝ) * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))
